text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
—And then, the two of them send up a 
towering pillar of fire.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
It's a pillar of fire that Chan couldn't 
raise alone. Vivid and dramatic. Everyone 
will look up at it in awe.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
"And that is when Ma-chan makes her 
long-awaited entrance. This is truly the 
grandest stage in full bloom."

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
In other words, let's make the Fillies' 
Revue your next race.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A few days have passed since the Hanshin 
JF. The true meaning of what happened that 
day remains unclear.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...Aston Machan never seeks consensus or 
gives explanations to begin with.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
However, I never expected that to extend 
even to me, her partner in the Twinkle 
Series.
choice_data_list:
(It doesn't seem like they don't trust me, 
either.)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Given that she was praised for her work, 
that must be it. Which means to her, this 
is probably just a normal sense of 
personal space.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
To begin with, every Umamusume and Trainer 
has their own way of relating to each 
other.
choice_data_list: (…I just need to do what she needs.)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Shaking off a faint tinge of loneliness, I 
shifted my mindset and walked through the 
campus, when—

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Whoa! What an interesting article.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: ...*peek*. ...*peek*.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
There she was, ostentatiously spreading 
open a magazine.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, what are you reading, Chan-Me-Chan? 
An interesting article?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Scarlett! Hehehe, that's right. Take a 
look at this page!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Let's see? Here? Umm...—

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
"The Classic Triple Crown route, or the 
Triple Tiara route? All eyes are on next 
year's leading star—Vodka!"

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
"Gaining overwhelming attention at the 
Hanshin JF, she skyrockets up the rankings 
as the hottest rookie Umamusume right 
now!"

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: ...Number one.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. Vodka is truly amazing, isn't she? 
I'm sure she'll be even more incredible 
next year.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: ...Scarlet?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
! Ah, I'm sorry, it's nothing! ...A-And, 
um, I just remembered I have something to 
do!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: See you, Machan!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Daiwa Scarlet walked briskly away. Aston 
Machan gazed after her receding figure 
until she was out of sight."

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: ...Haa! ...Haa!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Number one...? That kid is... among all 
the rookies?!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Win, win, win...! The one who wins is—

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: It's meeeeeee!!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
…………Aah, geez! So annoying, annoying, 
annoying!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
I'm number one! I'm number one, and 
yet...!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: ...Nngh! One more rep!!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Hey, Scarlet!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"The lights are already out! What if you 
trip and take a spill?!"

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
...Good grief. If Chan hadn't told me, I 
would've walked right past it.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Chan-chan...?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Nah, who cares about that right now? 
Aren't you acting way too reckless lately?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
...Not really. Everyone has their off 
days, right?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Even so. She's barely in her room, barely 
eats, and even during class she's just 
irritated, irritated, irritated...

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: ... ...I'm not doing that...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: I do. ...What, did something happen?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Hey—

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: It's your fault!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
"The most unstoppable rookie Umamusume 
right now"—Vodka!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Well, of course, after a race like that at 
the Hanshin JF! Everyone held their breath 
watching you!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: ...Before I even realized it...!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
...Still! That's why! I'm absolutely not 
giving this up anymore!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: First place belongs to me!!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: ...Ughhh, oh come on, this is the worst!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The dark grounds fell dead silent. A brief 
moment of quiet, and then—

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: I'm running in the Oka Sho too.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
I was hesitating for so long on what to do 
next. But now, I've decided!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
I'll clash with you at the Oka Sho. Then, 
I'll use you as a stepping stone to reach 
even greater heights!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: That's me at my absolute coolest!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
If it pisses you off, go beat 'em into the 
ground. Number one belongs to you, doesn't 
it?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: ………… ...Grrr, so annoying!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Wipe that smug look off your face! I'm 
gonna totally crush you at the Oka Sho!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Did you hear?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
I heard Vodka is running in the Oka Sho 
too. She's definitely running in the prep 
race, the Tulip Sho, as well.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
If I recall, didn't Aston Machan say 
something after the Hanshin Juvenile 
Fillies?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
That Vodka would likely enter the Tulip 
Sho as well.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
However, considering that, she sounded 
remarkably certain.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: The cast is assembled.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
"...First is the Tulip Sho. The flames 
burn bright, the cherry blossoms in full 
bloom. A stage of brilliance."

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
And the one who'll steal the show is 
Machan.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Aston Machan gazed out the window, wearing 
her usual gentle smile.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And from that day on, as if a switch had 
been flipped, she began throwing herself 
into training in earnest.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Taaaahhhhh--!!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: *gasp*, *pant*, *pant*...!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
This still isn't enough...! One more 
rep...!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Yaaaahhhh—!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her dedicated training bore fruit, and 
Aston Machan's skills were fully honed in 
preparation for the Oka Sho.
